items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; keep private. Woot documentation confirms API access but not commercial/public redistribution, storage, historical derivatives, display, alerts, affiliate, advertising, attribution, freshness, correction, or takedown rights. Current public terms point against the proposed use. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown, with 20 open banner/consent/GA4 findings and 4 privacy/terms findings. Security, operations, accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and owner gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required before rights outreach, data-use expansion, affiliate or advertising use, or public exposure. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only when it adds no new data collection, rights exposure, regulated claims, or monetization.

Launch-readiness tracking: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed; none may be closed from repository evidence alone. Existing partial evidence covers data flow and consent/analytics; source rights remain blocked. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle containing authoritative source-rights evidence, field-level data-flow and retention table, deployed consent and GA4 configuration evidence, and log/vendor/incident inventory. Then route rights, privacy, and jurisdiction questions to human counsel.

Do not clear SearchWoot accuracy, security, or release gates. Fleet-doctor has no run/findings/checks and operations has no deploy, uptime, or error-sweep results. Preserve private exposure. Continue only authorized read-only evidence capture; do not request duplicate telemetry, change credentials/configuration, deploy, or expand data processing.

Revenue evidence is limited to the 2026-09-21 Amazon window: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission under aggregate tracking_id=other. Do not assign it to any site or claim ROI, margin, forecast, or causal lift. No monetization expansion is cleared.
